thesis: Freedom and responsibility meet in unequal lives and require support for helpers as well as immediate rescue.

ideas.statement: We cannot save everything alone, but can take reasonable shares without letting powerful actors outsource duties; staying without submission matters alongside exit.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: The opening scene remains a thought experiment; unresolved ultimate will or theology does not remove practical capacities to change conditions.
